head: claude/mi117-probes-partial-take
title: ops: do NOT take PROBES.json from #10921 — main is already 23.8h newer; file the near-miss
body:
## What this is

Routed by `WO-20260905-PROBES-JSON-PARTIAL-TAKE-FROM-10921` to bring `docs/claude/PROBES.json` onto main **by value** from PR #10921, on the stated basis that the PR's copy was three days newer than main's.

**Re-measured at execution time, the take's direction has reversed.** main's copy is now newer than the PR's, so the take was **not** performed. This PR changes no register.

## The row-loss comparison, with its population

**MEASURED 2026-09-05**, both sides read from git (`origin/main` at `0849344`, PR head `a6fd170`):

| | `generated_at` | `results` rows | unique ids |
|---|---|--:|--:|
| **main** `docs/claude/PROBES.json` | `2026-09-04T09:45:04` | 34 | 34 |
| **PR #10921** `docs/claude/PROBES.json` | `2026-09-03T09:56:34` | 34 | 34 |

- ids on main **absent** from the PR: **0**
- ids in the PR **absent** from main: **0**

The id sets are identical, so the `OPEN-ITEMS.json` still-live / correctly-dropped classification the work object called for has **no rows to classify** — there is nothing that could be lost in either direction.

**Positive control on the instrument** (a search returning nothing is not proof of absence): the same set-difference code, run against a PR side with 3 ids deliberately removed, reported exactly those 3. The comparison can detect absence; its silence here is real.

## Why the take would have been a rewind

The whole-file diff between the two is **30 lines**, and **every** differing field is a *later* observation on main:

| field | main (2026-09-04) | PR (2026-09-03) |
|---|---|---|
| `trainer-capture-watch` runs listed | 8 | 3 |
| a `real_money` probe | `matched=2 scanned=200` | `matched=1 scanned=200` |
| `arbitration_fanout_soak` | `186/263` | `162/226` |
| `pr-queue-watch` | 4.7h ago, 14 PRs waiting | 4.9h ago, 8 PRs waiting |

Nothing in the PR's file is absent from main's. Taking it would have rewound main's probe register by **23.8h** — the same class of harm as `BL-20260905-A-WHOLESALE-DIRECTORY-COPY-REWOUND-FIVE-GENERATED-REGISTERS-AND-DROPPED-THREE-FILED-ROWS`, arrived at by following the remedy written for it.

The work object's own Done criterion reads *"stamp `2026-09-03T09:56:34` **or newer**"* — **main already satisfies it**, unchanged.

The PR's `DUE.json` (`2026-09-03T09:57:21`) is likewise **43h behind** main's (`2026-09-05T04:54:34`), so all three of #10921's files are stale and none is takeable. #10921 is being closed with a comment saying exactly this.

## What this PR actually changes

```
 .github/pr-automerge-requests/mi117-probes-partial-take.txt |  1 +
 .github/pr-landing/mi117-probes-partial-take.json           |  5 +++++
 docs/claude/health-review-backlog.json                      | 10 ++++++++++
 3 files changed, 16 insertions(+)
```

One backlog row, appended via `scripts/ops/backlog_append.py::append_row` (10 insertions, **0 deletions**, no reformat): `BL-20260905-A-ROUTED-DATA-TAKE-PRESCRIBED-A-REWIND-BECAUSE-ONLY-ITS-ROW-SET-WAS-RE-MEASURED-NOT-ITS-DIRECTION`. The work object correctly demanded the *row population* be re-measured but treated the *take direction* as settled fact; only one of the two axes that can go stale was covered.

**`docs/claude/PROBES.json`, `docs/claude/DUE.json` and `docs/claude/DUE.md` are untouched** — verified by `git diff origin/main...HEAD` on those three paths returning empty. No `src/`, `config/`, `deploy/` or workflow file is touched.

## Guards

`python3 scripts/ci/run_guards.py --base main` → **PASS 51 · FAIL 0 · SKIP 36**, all relevant guards passed.

> Note for reproduction: on a bare container the guard runner reports 3 spurious failures (`trainer-capture-watch-guard`, `artifact-validity-guard`, `operator-owed-guard`) because `pytest` is not installed and the shelled-out `python3 -m pytest` exits 1. With `pytest` installed all three pass on a clean tree — they were baselined that way *before* this change, so the green above is not this branch flattering itself.

Tier-1, self-landing: both `.github/pr-landing/<slug>.json` and `.github/pr-automerge-requests/<slug>.txt` are present, and the PR is opened ready (not a draft).
